# Candidate Assessment: Mandatory Requirements

| # | Mandatory Requirement | Candidate | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Listed under Languages | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Listed under Languages | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Listed under Platform | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Listed under Platform | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Listed under Services | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Listed under Services | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Listed under Services | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | None of the five listed | ❌ |
| 9 | Kafka | Not listed | ❌ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 7 of 10 = 70%**

Item 8 bundles five separate tools. If each tool counts on its own, the match drops to 7 of 14, or 50%. The result fails the cutoff under either method.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below Cutoff

The candidate's mandatory match is **70%**, which is below the **78% cutoff**. The gaps are all in containerization and infrastructure tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm), event streaming (Kafka), and GraphQL.

As instructed, I have **not evaluated the nice-to-have requirements**.
